statements.statement: CREATE SPACE IF NOT EXISTS lsqb (vid_type=INT64)
USE lsqb
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS Person(id: INT64)
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS Comment_(id: INT64)
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS Post(id: INT64)
CREATE TAG IF NOT EXISTS Forum(id: INT64)
CREATE EDGE IF NOT EXISTS KNOWS() FROM Person TO Person
CREATE EDGE IF NOT EXISTS HASCREATOR_COMMENT() FROM Comment_ TO Person
CREATE EDGE IF NOT EXISTS HASCREATOR_POST() FROM Post TO Person
CREATE EDGE IF NOT EXISTS REPLYOF_COMMENT() FROM Comment_ TO Comment_
CREATE EDGE IF NOT EXISTS REPLYOF_POST() FROM Comment_ TO Post
CREATE EDGE IF NOT EXISTS CONTAINEROF() FROM Forum TO Post
COPY TAG Person FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Person.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY TAG Comment_ FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Comment.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY TAG Post FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Post.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY TAG Forum FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Forum.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY EDGE KNOWS FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Person_knows_Person.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY EDGE HASCREATOR_COMMENT FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Comment_hasCreator_Person.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY EDGE HASCREATOR_POST FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Post_hasCreator_Person.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY EDGE REPLYOF_COMMENT FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Comment_replyOf_Comment.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY EDGE REPLYOF_POST FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Comment_replyOf_Post.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
COPY EDGE CONTAINEROF FROM '/data/kkkqkx/linkrs/parity/lsqb-sf0.1-v4/prepare/Forum_containerOf_Post.csv' WITH (HEADER true, DELIMITER '|')
